'''Spenter''' was an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. During an attack on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|dreadnaught]] near [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]], three Rebel pilots were killed by [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]], including Spenter.
